title: Nvidia Investigates CEO's Relationship Tied to Spy Probe
excerpt: Nvidia is looking into CEO Jensen Huang's personal affair following concerns regarding a potential Chinese spy.
body_html:
Nvidia has announced plans to investigate Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang regarding his personal relationship with a possible Chinese spy.

The situation came to light after Huang sent a memo to the company confirming that he had been involved in an affair.

The tech giant is currently reviewing the matter internally following the disclosure. Further details regarding the investigation or potential impacts on the company have not yet been released.
